en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2297 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"Indeed, Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, spread the earth from beneath the Kaaba to Mina, then from Mina to Arafat, and then from Arafat back to Mina. Thus, the earth extends from Arafat, Arafat is from Mina, and Mina is from the Kaaba. Similarly, our knowledge is derived, one from another."
